review.tagline: TypeScript template for remote MCP servers using Express and Effect
review.summary: A degit-able starter for a stateless remote MCP server built on the MCP TypeScript SDK, Express and Vite. It ships two example tools (echo and elicit_echo) with typed input and output schemas via Effect, plus an example Agent Skill published through the MCP Skills extension. Includes tests, ESLint, Prettier, a Dockerfile and a compose file with a health check.
review.audience: TypeScript developers starting a remote MCP server
strengths: Stateless HTTP transport per the MCP 2026-07-28 spec, with SDK fallback for older clients
Effect Schema adapted to MCP Standard Schema; tools declare outputSchema and structuredContent
Integration tests with in-memory client/server plus HTTP boundary tests
Example elicitation tool and a bundled skill served via skills/list and skills/get
weaknesses: Tool code is written in Effect style, bridged to the SDK with runMcpEffect
Only toy tools (echo, elicit_echo); no auth or persistence example
Needs TypeScript 7 plus a TypeScript 6 alias for typescript-eslint
Targets newer MCP spec revisions; Skills extension needs client support
